definitions.utility: Mean of independently fitted task-probe predictive R2 for P1->U and P2->V within each seed.
definitions.paired_change: Left arm minus right arm within each seed, then mean and sample SD across paired differences.
definitions.worst_individual: Maximum predictive R2 among P1->V,S and P2->U,S within each seed and probe family.
definitions.combined: Combined recipient may access U,V; only S is prohibited.
definitions.sample_sd: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1), undefined with fewer than two defined seeds.
definitions.undefined: Undefined inputs remain null and counts expose coverage; undefined validation evidence cannot pass.
definitions.scope: Empirical finite-budget attacks and utility only; no universal privacy guarantee.
definitions.selection: Positive selected arm is read from each seed's saved validation selection; this script performs no selection.
